protocol: Progressive Pyramid Protocol - Four Corners + Center Point

must: recover prior work, evidence, and decisions
inherit V1 without discarding verified gains
strengthen against the original finish line
adversarially inspect errors, regressions, hidden harms, contradictions, safety, legality, requirements
correct defects without weakening prior capabilities
apply available agents, tools, connectors, sources, and authorized execution surfaces
advance the actual deliverable and operational outcome
continue unresolved work instead of claiming completion
stages.output: MISSION_COMPLETE only when original acceptance conditions are demonstrably satisfied

completion_rule.mission_complete_requires: demonstrated satisfaction of original externally observable acceptance criteria
completion_rule.blocked_execution: preserve blocker and alternate routes; never claim completion
completion_rule.spiral_engine_alignment: distinguishes local quality completion from mission-outcome completion
